column1: # Signal calibration conditions (issue #28), run by run_conditions.sh with
# name under $INPUTS, or "-" for real reads), extra eval.sh arguments
# ($PS, $INPUTS and $TABLES are expanded). Rows were run in this order with
# the profile of commit f1d26a0 (the pre-calibration presets); the DNA
# preset is unchanged since. --keep keeps calls and pod5 for fit_table.py /
#   hg38.fa     2000 pseudo-reads, 10,016,863 bases, GC 0.4093, cut from
#               UCSC hg38 at regions.tsv (seed 28, chr1-22/X, 2-8 kb,
#   uniform.fa  the same 2000 lengths cut from `phantom-science generate
#               (PromethION FLO-PRO114M, 5 kHz, 5325 reads; sha256 in TOOLS.lock)
# Round 2: which part of squigulator's lead on hg38 is its table, its
# per-k-mer stdv, its level offset or its dwell. $TABLES holds tables
# derived with squig_table.py (squigulator's built-in R10 table, recovered
# from --ideal / --ideal-time signal of a de Bruijn sequence) and the ONT
# table in pA as an f5c-format model for squigulator --kmer-model:
# fitted_ont.txt: ONT's table refit to the real reads by fit_table.py
# Round 3: squigulator's levels (constant stdv) as the base for composition, noise
# and a level refit against real reads (fit_table.py).
